name: Sentinel Selarin
summary: In Auberdine, Sentinel Selarin seeks aid for Ashenvale’s defenders. She brings Raene Wolfrunner’s appeal to the coastal settlement as dangers threaten the forest.

sections.title: A Plea for Reinforcements
sections.body: Sentinel Selarin brings Raene Wolfrunner’s appeal from Ashenvale to Auberdine. Threats across the forest have stretched its garrison thin. So Selarin follows the forest road north into Darkshore, seeking Terenthis and help from the sentinels and scouts stationed on the coast.

sections.title: Rallying the Wayfarers
sections.body: Terenthis cannot answer Selarin’s appeal in person, so she stays in Auberdine and calls on travelers passing through Darkshore. She sends capable adventurers south to Astranaar, where they can bring their blades and spells to Raene Wolfrunner’s beleaguered forces.

faq.answer: Sentinel Selarin is a night elf warrior of the Sentinels. In Auberdine, she carries messages and seeks aid for Ashenvale’s defenders.

faq.q: Why did Selarin come to Auberdine?
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner ordered Selarin to find Terenthis in Auberdine and seek reinforcements against the growing dangers in Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why didn't Terenthis go to Ashenvale with her?
faq.answer: Terenthis is occupied with local duties and cannot go to Ashenvale. Selarin recruits independent Alliance travelers to journey south in his place.
Selarin sends adventurers south across the border into Ashenvale to report to Raene Wolfrunner at Astranaar.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you meet Selarin in Darkshore as she helps travelers journey south into Ashenvale’s contested wilderness.
As a night elf, you share the Sentinels’ duty to guard the ancestral borders of the kaldorei.
